verdict.rationale: React's own docs say it can start streaming HTML on the server while data is still loading, progressively filling in content before any JavaScript loads (react-docs-6). This matches the story directly. Server rendering (react-gh-2) and hydrateRoot, which attaches React to server-generated HTML (react-docs-9, react-docs-26), complete the flow. missing for 10: detailed reference docs for the streaming API itself (e.g. the streaming render function and Suspense boundary behavior), independent or hands-on confirmation of perceived-load gains.
